name: Spotify
tagline: Freemium audio platform: music, podcasts, audiobooks and now video
facts: 2006, Stockholm, by Daniel Ek and Martin Lorentzon
FY25 net income ~$1.17B; consistently profitable since 2024
Co-CEOs Alex Norström, Gustav Söderström (2026); Ek chairman
Launched 2019; big MAU, low ARPU market

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: Unlock the potential of human creativity by giving creators a living and fans enjoyment of their art.

strategy.label: Vision
strategy.text: Be the world's audio and creator platform, ubiquitous on every device, in every country.

strategy.label: Core strategy
strategy.text: Freemium funnel: free ad tier acquires users, personalisation converts them to Premium, price rises lift margin.

strategy.label: Moat
strategy.text: Personalisation data (Discover Weekly, Wrapped, DJ), habit, playlists and device ubiquity across cars, speakers, consoles.

strategy.label: Key bet
strategy.text: Beyond music: video podcasts, audiobooks in Premium, AI DJ; diversify away from label royalties eating ~70% revenue.

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: Ad revenue shrank in 2025 while subs grew; should Spotify keep a free tier at all?

customers.pain: Want music free, accept ads, low willingness to pay
customers.why: Biggest free catalogue, good recommendations, on every device

customers.pain: Ads, shuffle limits, no offline listening
customers.why: Ad-free, offline, best personalisation, audiobook hours, family and duo plans

customers.pain: Discovery and fair royalties in crowded market
customers.why: Largest paying audience; Spotify for Artists, Marquee, Discovery Mode promotion
Partner Program pays for Premium consumption; video podcasts, built-in ads

customers.pain: Reach audio-first users with measurable impact
customers.why: Spotify Ad Exchange, streaming audio and podcast ads, first-party data

products.name: Spotify Free
products.desc: Ad-supported shuffle listening, the top of funnel

products.name: Spotify Premium
products.desc: Individual, Duo, Family, Student ad-free plans

products.name: Personalisation
products.desc: Discover Weekly, AI DJ, AI playlists, Daylist, Wrapped

products.name: Spotify for Artists
products.desc: Analytics, Marquee and Discovery Mode promotion tools

portfolio.north_star: Weekly listening hours per MAU that drive Premium conversion
portfolio.key_metrics: MAU, free-to-paid conversion, Premium ARPU, churn, streams per user
portfolio.guardrails: Royalty cost per stream, artist sentiment, price-hike churn

products.name: Video podcasts
products.desc: ~500K video shows; 390M+ users have streamed one

products.name: Spotify Partner Program
products.desc: Pays creators for Premium video podcast consumption

products.name: Spotify for Creators
products.desc: Hosting, recording and analytics, formerly Anchor

portfolio.north_star: Weekly podcast listeners who also stream music
portfolio.key_metrics: Podcast MAU share, video watch time, show count, ad fill
portfolio.guardrails: Content cost per hour, brand safety, music engagement not dropping

products.name: Audiobooks in Premium
products.desc: 15 hours monthly included; top-ups and add-on

products.name: Spotify Ad Exchange
products.desc: Programmatic audio, video and podcast ad marketplace

products.name: Spotify Audience Network
products.desc: Ad network across Spotify and partner podcasts

portfolio.north_star: Ad and audiobook gross profit per user
portfolio.key_metrics: Ad revenue growth, CPMs, audiobook hours, attach rate
portfolio.guardrails: Ads per hour, free-user retention, publisher payout disputes

rows.how: Flat fee; ~2/3 of revenue paid to rights holders
Audio, video and podcast ads sold direct and programmatically
Monthly listening hours bundled; publishers paid per usage
Marquee, Showcase, Discovery Mode lower royalty for promotion

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: 777M users, 300M payers (~39%); free tier is the acquisition funnel, not the profit engine.

bullets.label: Unit economics
bullets.text: Gross margin hit record 33.4% Q2 2026; royalties variable, so price hikes and non-music content lift margin.

bullets.label: Growth levers
bullets.text: Price increases, superfan tier, video podcasts, audiobooks, emerging-market subs, ad-tech rebuild.

bullets.label: Lesson
bullets.text: Aggregator without owned supply: profitability came only after cost cuts, pricing power and bundling non-music.

friction: Free tier shuffle and skip limits on mobile
Home feed cluttered by podcasts, audiobooks and video
Price hikes across all tiers in 2026
Artists complain about low per-stream payouts
Audiobook hour caps confuse Premium users

competitors.label: Music streaming
competitors.text: Apple Music, YouTube Music, Amazon Music, JioSaavn

competitors.label: Podcasts and video
competitors.text: YouTube (biggest podcast platform), Apple Podcasts, Netflix video podcasts

competitors.label: Audiobooks
competitors.text: Audible, Apple Books, Pocket FM in India

competitors.label: Attention
competitors.text: TikTok and Shorts as music discovery engines

competitors.label: Edge
competitors.text: Best-in-class personalisation, platform-agnostic ubiquity, cultural moments like Wrapped

competitors.label: Risk
competitors.text: Label leverage, Apple/Google platform fees, YouTube bundling music with video

news.label: Jul 2026
news.text: Q2: 300M subs, 777M MAU, €655M operating income, record 33.4% gross margin

news.label: Jan 2026
news.text: Norström and Söderström become co-CEOs; Daniel Ek moves to executive chairman

news.label: Jan 2026
news.text: US price hikes: individual $12.99, Family $21.99, Student $6.99

news.label: Watch
news.text: Superfan tier launch, video podcast monetisation, ad business turnaround

sources: Spotify 20-F FY25, Q2 2026 6-K, MBW and press coverage. Metrics are PM estimates for interview prep. Prepared Oct 2026.
